tools.name: review_code
tools.description: Runs a non-exhaustive static heuristic review of pasted HTML, CSS, or JavaScript against multiple frontend best practices and returns prioritized issues, fix guidance, and suggestions for manual verification. Use it when the user requests a review, audit, or debugging of source code. An empty issue

tools.name: audit_url
tools.description: Fetches a public HTTPS page and performs a non-exhaustive static review of its HTML, returning prioritized issues and fix guidance. Use it when the user requests an audit of a deployed public page. Localhost, private networks, and plain HTTP URLs are refused. It does not execute the page, measure li

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Returns the ordered steps of a curated audit workflow, including rule slugs, priorities, and categories. Use it when the user requests a structured audit such as a pre-launch checklist. Available workflows: accessibility-essentials, comprehensive-audit, core-web-vitals, html-foundations, image-optim

tools.name: get_checklist_rules
tools.description: Returns titles, priorities, verification and remediation prompts for every rule in a curated checklist. Use it when the user requests guidance for an entire checklist. includeContent optionally adds each rule’s long-form body. Available checklists: accessibility-essentials, comprehensive-audit, core

tools.name: get_quick_reference
tools.description: Returns a compact checklist for one frontend category, filtered by priority and formatted as JSON, Markdown, or a task list. Use it when the user requests a concise checklist for a deployment, review, or team handoff.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Returns complete guidance for one known rule slug: requirements, rationale, verification and remediation prompts, code examples, sources, and related rules. Use it when the user requests detailed guidance for a specific frontend rule. Unknown slugs return similar suggestions.

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Finds frontend rules by keywords, category, and priority, returning paginated slugs, titles, and short summaries. Use it when the user requests relevant practices for a technology, concern, or pattern, such as web fonts or accessible forms.

tools.name: check_rule
tools.description: Checks a code snippet against one named frontend rule using static heuristics and returns findings and verification guidance. Without code, returns manual verification guidance. Use it when the user requests a check of a specific rule or a proposed fix. Results do not establish rendered-state or run

tools.name: fix_rule
tools.description: Returns step-by-step remediation guidance and priority for one named frontend rule. Use it when the user requests implementation or fix instructions for a known issue. Optional codeSnippet provides context; the tool does not edit files or apply changes.

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Explains one frontend rule, including its background, impact on users and the business, and related categories. Use it when the user asks why a practice matters or requests educational context. It returns explanation guidance rather than applying a fix.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists available frontend rule categories, their descriptions, and rule counts. Use it when the user asks what the checklist covers or needs valid category names.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "review_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "review_code" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
